reviews.claim_text: He recalls an earlier word about people being made to want electric cars in the days ahead, and wonders aloud whether it was about America or about Russia.
reviews.note: First telling threaded under its own claim. The open question about which country is his, not an inference.

reviews.claim_text: Flagging it as his own speculation rather than a word, he wonders whether Russia's power grid will be hit next, its power plants struck, leaving the country without power.
reviews.note: He labels it just me talking. Left unattached rather than folded into the grid cyberattack claim, which is about America.

reviews.claim_text: He says he saw lines of cars, of people trying to get fuel.
reviews.note: Repeats the Russian fuel queue image he had already given, prompted by the headlines he read earlier in the video.

reviews.claim_text: He says the Lord said Turkey will not abandon Syria or let Israel draw a red line, and that Turkey and Syria will come together even to defend Russia in the days ahead, adding that both of the named leaders are evil.
reviews.note: Extends the alliance to defending Russia and adds the Israeli red line that Turkey will not accept.

reviews.claim_text: He notes that five doomsday planes are flying at one time and prays that they find what they are looking for.
reviews.note: An observation about aircraft movements he says are happening now, not a forecast.

reviews.claim_text: He says he saw a dirty thing up in the northeast, very serious, a yellow fog that went off inside a building, which he calls a tactical thing.
reviews.note: First telling. Kept apart from the Iran dirty bomb retaliation claim, which names a different actor and trigger.

reviews.claim_text: He says they are praying against hidden cells inside the nation.
reviews.note: Repeats the standing hidden cells claim, here tied to the northeast device.

reviews.claim_text: He says he saw lead encasing in Cuba, inside a mountain, and that the Lord said cold alliances, cold war alliances, calling for heightened alert.
reviews.note: Puts the lead-encased thing in a Cuban mountain, where the earlier telling left the location open.

reviews.claim_text: Reading a report of a magnitude 5.0 in northern California near San Francisco, he asks whether this is the one the Lord spoke of and repeats that quakes are going to start upticking, tying it to the San Francisco and Portland word.
reviews.note: He raises the 5.0 as a possible fulfilment but does not assert it, so it stays a mention here and not evidence. The upticking line is the forward part.

reviews.claim_text: He says he still feels something major is about to happen and has an urgency inside himself.
reviews.note: Another repeat of the standing something major impression, with urgency attached.

reviews.claim_text: He says he saw Venezuela again with battleships all around it, and that the Lord said this is more than drug trafficking: it is a front meant to cause a pause in the BRICS system, because BRICS had been reaching out to Venezuela.
reviews.note: Adds the mechanism: the deployment as a front to pause BRICS, not only to squeeze its oil money.

reviews.claim_text: He says Russia, China and others had been reaching out to Venezuela and to Saudi Arabia for oil because they needed those resources to back and strengthen BRICS, and that the American move keeps the dollar's face safe for this season.
reviews.note: Names who was reaching out and puts a season on the dollar reprieve.

reviews.claim_text: He says he keeps seeing that the Venezuelan leader will be like a Saddam, and that the Lord told him it is not all about drugs, ten percent, but ninety percent about the oil.
reviews.note: Repeats the Saddam comparison already on this thread.

reviews.claim_text: He sees a Gaddafi-like or Saddam-like man being overthrown in the days ahead.
reviews.note: Adds a near horizon, in the days ahead, and a second comparison figure in Gaddafi.

reviews.claim_text: He says it will be about stabilising the dollar and that the new energy will come out of this.
reviews.note: Ties the new energy to the Venezuelan oil move as its origin. New energy is unqualified here; the water energy identification comes elsewhere in the same video.

reviews.claim_text: Reading a Newsweek headline saying the president was right about Venezuela, he repeats drill baby drill and says major oil and gas is coming.
reviews.note: The headline is news; the forward part is a repeat of the oil and gas boom. His the Lord warned us is a fulfilment assertion and stays out of the validation table.

reviews.claim_text: Praying over America, he thanks God for things accelerating with wars and rumours of wars and for the digital golden age that he says is coming.
reviews.note: Calls the golden age digital, which is new against the plain golden age wording earlier in the same video.

reviews.claim_text: He prays that the glorious church will rise up, be bold as a lion and not shrink back or be cowards in this hour.
reviews.note: First telling threaded under its own claim.

reviews.claim_text: Speaking over footage of what he calls top brass from the KGB, he says a doomsday weapon is coming, that it is something of vast magnitude, and that they have to protect the Russian homeland.
reviews.note: First telling. Kept apart from the unconventional weapons claim, which names a Cuban bioweapon rather than a Russian doomsday device.

reviews.claim_text: He says that after this happens the European nations look toward America and ask whether it will come in and defend them because of NATO.
reviews.note: First telling. Distinct from the NATO as bargaining chip claim, which is about Trump and Putin trading over NATO rather than Europe appealing to it.
